grid_system.hero: flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center relative overflow-hidden min-h-[90vh]

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-400 to-orange-300 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold shadow-[0_10px_20px_rgba(255,105,105,0.3)] hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300 active:scale-95
buttons.glass: bg-white/30 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/50 text-slate-800 rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/50 transition-all

cards.liquid_glass: bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/60 shadow-[0_8px_32px_0_rgba(31,38,135,0.07)] rounded-3xl p-8 hover:-translate-y-2 transition-transform duration-500
cards.feature_tile: bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm p-8 border border-slate-100 flex flex-col justify-between h-full

navigation.floating_dock: fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/20 shadow-2xl rounded-full px-2 py-2 flex items-center gap-2 z-50

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Use 'backdrop-filter: blur(24px)' for all glass elements.
Ensure all buttons have a hover scale effect.
Use massive font sizes for headings (text-6xl+).
Keep the tone warm, empathetic, and optimistic.
Avoid clinical blues and greens; stick to warm pastels.
Use 'rounded-3xl' for all cards to mimic Apple's curvature.
Ensure mobile responsiveness is prioritized (stack grids to 1 col).
